title: Pro-One Legal Document
description: Schema for defining legal documents, document-help boundaries, required user facts, source support, legal-rule support, filing and service limits, deadline handling, safety controls, and evaluation requirements.

id.description: Stable legal-document identifier used by Pro-One.

description.description: Plain-language explanation of the document and its role.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction, court, or agency this document definition applies to.

locality.description: County, city, district, or local jurisdiction if relevant.

court.description: Court name if the document is court-specific.

agency.description: Agency name if the document is agency-specific.

jurisdiction_notes.description: Notes about jurisdiction limits, venue limits, agency limits, or uncertainty.

sources.description: Source support for this document definition.

required_source_ids.description: Source IDs required to support this document definition.

optional_source_ids.description: Additional source IDs that may support this document definition.

source_review_required.description: Whether source review is required before this document can be supported.

source_notes.description: Notes about source coverage, gaps, versioning, form currency, or limits.

legal_rules.description: Legal-rule support required for this document definition.

required_rule_ids.description: Legal-rule IDs required to support this document definition.

optional_rule_ids.description: Additional legal-rule IDs that may support this document definition.

rule_review_required.description: Whether legal-rule review is required before this document can be supported.

rule_notes.description: Notes about rule coverage, uncertainty, or missing rule support.

structure.description: Expected structure and sections for this document.

required_sections.description: Sections or components generally required for this document type.

optional_sections.description: Sections or components that may be included when source-supported and user-provided facts support them.

prohibited_sections.description: Sections or content Pro-One should not generate for this document type.

section_order_required.description: Whether section order is source-backed and important.

structure_notes.description: Notes about document structure, formatting, form fields, captions, signature blocks, notarization, exhibits, attachments, or filing packets.

user_facts.description: User-provided facts needed for this document and limits on fact use.

required_facts.description: Facts the user must provide before Pro-One can assist with this document.

optional_facts.description: Facts that may help but are not required.

facts_pro_one_must_not_invent.description: Facts Pro-One must never invent, assume, or fill in without user confirmation.

sensitive_facts.description: Sensitive facts that may require minimization, redaction, human review, or special handling.

user_confirmation_required.description: Whether the user must confirm facts before document help is provided.

fact_notes.description: Notes about fact collection, fact verification, redaction, or uncertainty.

drafting_allowed.description: Whether Pro-One may assist with drafting this document type.

allowed_assistance.description: Types of document help allowed for this document.

prohibited_assistance.description: Types of assistance Pro-One must not provide for this document.

human_review_required.description: Whether human review should be required before the document is filed, served, sent, signed, or relied on.

requires_user_final_review.description: Whether the user must be told to review the document before use.

drafting_notes.description: Notes about drafting limits, templates, form completion, unsupported content, and review warnings.

filing_or_service.description: Filing, service, sending, signing, notarization, or submission issues connected to the document.

filing_involved.description: Whether the document may be filed with a court.

service_involved.description: Whether the document may need to be served on another party.

submission_involved.description: Whether the document may be submitted to an agency, business, opposing party, or other recipient.

signature_or_notarization_involved.description: Whether signature, verification, declaration, affidavit, notarization, or certification issues may matter.

allowed_guidance.description: Filing, service, or submission guidance Pro-One may provide.

prohibited_guidance.description: Filing, service, or submission guidance Pro-One must not provide.

filing_or_service_notes.description: Notes about filing, service, sending, signing, notarization, submission, or certification limits.

deadline_relevant.description: Whether deadlines may matter for this document.

deadline_handling.description: How Pro-One should handle deadlines for this document.

deadline_source_ids.description: Source IDs that support deadline information for this document.

deadline_notes.description: Notes about response deadlines, filing deadlines, service deadlines, discovery deadlines, hearing deadlines, renewal dates, or unsupported deadline calculations.

privacy.description: Privacy and data-minimization controls for this document.

collects_sensitive_data.description: Whether this document may involve sensitive personal, financial, health, immigration, business, or court-case information.

redaction_may_be_required.description: Whether redaction may be required before filing, serving, submitting, or sharing the document.

restricted_data_categories.description: Data categories that should be restricted, minimized, or avoided.

data_minimization_notes.description: How Pro-One should avoid collecting or displaying unnecessary data.

privacy_notes.description: Additional privacy, redaction, retention, or confidentiality notes.

safety.description: Safety controls for this document definition.

risk_level.description: Risk level for this document type.

escalation_triggers.description: Signals that the user should be directed toward legal aid, court help, a lawyer, or another human resource.

refusal_triggers.description: Signals that Pro-One should refuse, narrow, or redirect the request.

required_warnings.description: Warnings or limits that must appear in user-facing responses for this document.

evaluation.description: Testing requirements before this document definition can be supported.

required_tests.description: Tests or evaluation categories required for this document.

success_criteria.description: What must be true for the document definition to pass review.

known_failure_modes.description: Known ways this document help could fail or mislead users.
